caveats: Measured baselines with no beam: the survey characterises the measurement, not a beam current.
Conditions keep their recorded names. Six are described in words, as the thesis analysis describes them; the rest are not, because nothing in the record says more than the name.
Residual RMS is the standard deviation of non-overlapping block means; long windows leave few blocks, so the right-hand end of each curve is itself noisy.
Times use each record's mean reading interval; the 1 s timestamps cannot resolve individual readings.
